objectives.en: Make a rumble bass between kicks

text.ru: Рамбл — низкий гул на офф-битах, приглушённый и тёмный.
text.en: The rumble is a low hum on the off-beats, muted and dark.

text.ru: [SHIFT] + [RECORD SETTING] — SOUND GENERATOR. [CTRL 1] — Type (Sine…), [CTRL 2] — Freq, [CTRL 3] — Level; [REC] и пэд сохраняют звук.
text.en: [SHIFT] + [RECORD SETTING] — SOUND GENERATOR. [CTRL 1] is Type (Sine…), [CTRL 2] Freq, [CTRL 3] Level; [REC] and a pad save the sound.

text.ru: Удерживая [SUB PAD], выбери бас и нажми пэды шагов 2, 6, 10, 14: пэд = шаг.
text.en: Holding [SUB PAD], pick the bass and press the step pads 2, 6, 10, 14: pad = step.

text.ru: Затемни: [FILTER+DRIVE], FLT TYPE LPF, CUTOFF вниз; DRIVE добавляет «зерно».
text.en: Darken it: [FILTER+DRIVE], FLT TYPE LPF, CUTOFF down; DRIVE adds grain.
